experiment_data.hypothesis: Tail-truncation concentrates diagnostic signal (final execution states, exceptions) at training time. If this hypothesis holds, Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B with tail-2048 truncation should achieve accuracy comparable to 7B tail-2048 (97.31%), significantly outperforming head-truncation baselines on the same model size.
